title: All Is Violent, All Is Bright

drums.tags: Industrial techno with heavy distortion and experimental sound design. A distorted kick drum with a long, saturated sub-tail provides the rhythmic pulse at 130 BPM in the key of C minor. A high-pass filtered, metallic percussion loop with heavy reverb creates a rhythmic texture in the upper frequencies. A resonant, modulated synth lead with a sawtooth waveform enters with a syncopated, three-note motif. The track features aggressive sidechain compression on all melodic elements, triggered by the kick. A white noise riser with a resonant filter sweep builds tension before a sudden cut to silence. The percussion utilizes bit-crushing and sample-rate reduction for a gritty, lo-fi texture. A low-frequency oscillator modulates the cutoff frequency of a distorted bass synth, creating a rhythmic growl.

bass.tags: Hard rock and heavy metal instrumental. Distorted electric guitars play palm-muted chugging riffs and syncopated power chords. A double-kick drum kit features a punchy snare and bright crash cymbals. The electric bass follows the guitar riffs with a gritty, overdriven tone. The track is in 4/4 time at 140 BPM in the key of E minor. The arrangement alternates between mid-tempo groove-oriented sections and faster, double-time thrash-influenced passages. High-gain guitar leads utilize pinch harmonics and rapid alternate picking. The production is modern with a wide stereo image for the rhythm guitars and a centered, dry drum mix.
